steps.text: Talk to Gertrude west of Varrock to start the quest.
Pickup some Doogle Leaves south of Gertrude's house.
Use your Doogle Leaves on  the Sardine.
Talk to Shilop or Wilough in the Varrock Square.
choices: What will make you tell me?

steps.text: Climb up the ladder in the Lumberyard.
Use a bucket of milk on Gertrude's cat upstairs in the Lumberyard north east of Varrock.
Climb up the ladder in the Lumberyard.
Use a seasoned sardine on Gertrude's cat upstairs in the Lumberyard north east of Varrock.
Search different crates downstairs in the Lumberyard until you find the kitten.
Climb down ladder in the Lumberyard.
Climb up the ladder in the Lumberyard.
Return the kitten to Gertrude's cat.
Return to Gertrude west of Varrock to complete the quest.
